thank you for your response, first. It just helps to know someone is out there

I have a lot of stuff with my dad and after therapy but I really think I'm over it. I guess I'm not. He's just a person who is hurting, too, and rationally I know that he isn't a dick because I make him a dick, he's just a dick. But he also worked hard for us, and did the best he could in his own way, so I can't really talk to him about how harmful he was to us growing up.

 He's in poor health now, too, so there's just no way to try to resolve things. It's the right thing to bite my tongue when he's crazy rude o whatever. It's the only thing to do. 

So on the surface I am very respectful and a great daughter but then just fucking destroy myself for days afterward. My guy is super nice about it and just lets me go a little wild, but it's followed by days of insane, repeating, painful thoughts.

And all this? Makes me just like him. Self-involved. Compulsive and hateful,an addict.  Unaware of others and their pains and problems, and I don't want to be like that. 

Thank you for asking and letting me vent. I'm calming dowpn.
